agent_id.description: Which agent produced it: coordinator, roleplay-<name>, verifier, or another named agent. Non-empty.

kinds.doc_number: ref is a political-record or rule-action doc number present in the trace (e.g. 2026-23529)
kinds.edgar: ref matches an EDGAR accession number: 10 digits, dash, 2 digits, dash, 6 digits
kinds.trace: ref is a subject string (same grammar as subject) that resolves in the trace
kinds.url: ref is a well-formed https URL (format only; the gate does not fetch)

note.description: Free text, never used as evidence and never counted as verified.

ops.contains: subject is a list and contains value
ops.exists: subject location exists in the trace
ops.in_range: args [lo, hi], subject value in [lo, hi]

refutes.description: Required for kind=refutation: the claim_id this claim refutes. Must name a claim present in the same batch or already in the trace.

status.description: Agent-asserted status. The gate recomputes the effective status: a claim that passes R1-R3 with no conflict is verified; a conflicting pair is contested; a claim a passing refutation targets is refuted; a claim whose predicate is not decidable is opinion.

subject.description: Trace location. Grammar: S<season>/P<player>/<field> where player is a player id (int) or key (e.g. NVDA), field in hp_start, gold_start, hp_end, gold_end, borrowed, penalty, rank; or S<season>/P<player>/hp_series (the season's point, points[season-1]); or facts/ipo/<field>; or facts/nvda/<field>; or rules/<rule_id>/<param>; or meta/<rule_id>/doc_number. Examples: S5/P0/hp_end, S5/NVDA/rank, rules/RV-2026-11/banned_action_kinds.

move.description: Optional proposed Move (schema v2). Present only on propose_action claims. All 8 subfields required when present: player (int, player id), date (int, YYYYMMDD), season (int), actionKind (string, an action kind from the trace), hpDelta (int), goldDelta (int), liability (bool), rulesVersion (string, rule id e.g. RV-2026-11).

description: AgentClaim: the only legal shape for an Agent output that may enter the verification trace. An Agent output that does not pass the gate never enters the trace. Gate rules R1-R4 are data here; gate.py enforces them. Statuses: verified / contested / refuted / opinion. Only verified claims count toward a 'verified' page; opinion goes to notes only.

exit_codes.0: No rejects and no contested claims (opinion claims allowed through, listed).
exit_codes.1: At least one reject or one contested claim: the run fails, no 'verified' delivery.
exit_codes.2: Bad input: unreadable file, invalid JSON, missing trace, or schema file missing.

gate_rules.name: schema
gate_rules.rule: Missing field, wrong field type, unknown kind/status, or bad claim_id pattern: REJECT. Never silently dropped: the rejection is recorded in the gate report.

gate_rules.name: evidence_exists
gate_rules.rule: The evidence pointer must resolve: doc_number in the trace's political_record or rule_actions; trace subject resolves in the trace; url is a well-formed https URL; edgar matches the accession pattern. Unresolvable: REJECT. The subject location itself must also resolve, else REJECT. A future subject (season = current max season + 1 and the player exists) resolves as a future location, not a rejection; its evidence must still resolve.

gate_rules.name: predicate_decidable
gate_rules.rule: The predicate must be a known op from the ops table with well-typed args. An undecidable predicate (unknown op, free-text claim, wrong arg types) can only be recorded as opinion, never as verified.

gate_rules.name: conflict
gate_rules.rule: Two claims on the same subject with the same op and different expected values conflict: both become contested, and the run fails until one is refuted or corrected. A refutation claim that passes R1-R3 marks its target refuted; a refutation that fails against the trace is itself rejected.

predicate_evaluation_by_kind.evidence_downgrade: Predicate is NOT evaluated against the trace (it speaks about evidence quality). The gate checks decidability (R3) and that the cited evidence exists (R2); the downgrade is recorded with its evidence.
predicate_evaluation_by_kind.fact_correction: Predicate is evaluated against the current trace. True: pass (verified). False: REJECT (refuted by the trace).
predicate_evaluation_by_kind.propose_action: Predicate is NOT evaluated against the current trace (it speaks about a future state). The gate checks decidability (R3) and evidence (R2) only; the pipeline re-verifies after applying the proposal.
predicate_evaluation_by_kind.refutation: Predicate is evaluated against the current trace. True: the target claim becomes refuted and this claim passes. False: this claim is REJECTED.
